description: Checks that the time is still free and returns a secure booking link with tour, date, time, guests and extras already filled in. Give this link to the guest: they check the details and pay there. Guest details are optional ('guest'): pass them only if the guest gave them to you for this booking; then name, e-mail and/or phone are filled in on the booking page. They are stored on our server for at most 24 hours and are not in the link itself. No e-mail is sent before payment; the guest confirms the booking by paying. Nothing is reserved or charged by this tool.

guest.description: Optional. Only if the guest gave you these for this booking. Each field is optional.

email.description: E-mail address for the confirmation (sent only after payment).

name.description: Full name of the guest who books.

phone.description: Phone number with country code, e.g. +31 6 12345678.

guests.description: Number of guests in the group (adults and children together).

options.description: Optional extras, keyed by option id (or option name) from get_tour. Value: the chosen text for a choice, true for a yes/no extra, a number for a quantity.

time.description: Start time HH:MM, one of the free times from check_availability.

tour.description: Tour id (the "tour" value from list_tours, e.g. "cosy-tour").

name: create_booking_link
title: Create booking link
